name: libc++
description: LLVM's implementation of the C++ standard library, built as a standalone component against the already-installed LLVM/Clang 21.1.8, using libc++abi as its ABI runtime.
build: cmake -G Ninja -S llvm-project-21.1.8.src/runtimes -B llvm-project-21.1.8.src/runtimes/build -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PREFIX" -D LLVM_ENABLE_RUNTIMES=libcxx -D LLVM_DIR="$PREFIX/lib/cmake/llvm" -D LIBCXX_CXX_ABI=libcxxabi -D LIBCXX_CXX_ABI_INCLUDE_PATHS="$PREFIX/include/c++/v1" -D LIBCXX_CXX_ABI_LIBRARY_PATH="$PREFIX/lib"
